text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P2 — container crashloop detected in pool us-west-2-gpu-3 (runtime-engine). 150 restarts in 8m, SIGSEGV in /opt/runtime/plugins/trt_custom.so. Pager: hana (oncall). See runbook: /runbooks/runtime-crashloop
hana (oncall): ack — taking pager now, jumping into logs and health checks.
morgan: seeing elevated 5xx for several dedicated customers routed to us-west-2. Error rate ~4.8% over 5m, tail-latency spikes to 6s for some requests.
sam: quick log snippet from pod runtime-evict-3f2:
```
2026-03-17T02:12:34Z runtime ERROR SIGSEGV at 0x7fff... in trt_custom_infer()
Backtrace:
  trt_custom.so(+0x1a3f) [0x7f9c1a3f]
  libnvrtc.so(...) 
  ...
```
julia: was there a plugin update last night? I recall a TRT custom plugin bump.
tamir: yes, plugin trt_custom v2.3.4 rolled in canary at 03:10 UTC and promoted at 03:30 — that aligns with the spike window.
hana (oncall): mitigation plan: cordon gpu-3-12 and drain pods on that node, scale down pool us-west-2-gpu-3 to 0 (graceful drain), and failover traffic to us-west-2-gpu-1 standby pool. Also prepare env toggle to disable custom trt path if quick rollback needed.
morgan: customers impacted: acme-inc (dedicated) showing ~12% request failures during peak; beta-saas had increased error budget burn. CS already alerted for SLAs.
nora-cs: notified ACME and Beta-SaaS with an initial message and status page link. They'll escalate if customer ops asks for more.
sam: actionable quick fix: set env TRITON_DISABLE_CUSTOM=1 on runtime daemonset to bypass the custom TRT plugin (hotpatch). Command:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env ds/runtime TRITON_DISABLE_CUSTOM=1 --record
```
I can roll that on the pool selector first (label selector pool=us-west-2-gpu-3) before global.
hana (oncall): apply to pool now, then watch restarts.
(small pause)
hana (oncall): applied env to pool selector, initiating rolling restart. Observed restart rate drop within 90s. Crashloop counts decreasing.
morgan: error rate down to 0.6% and tail latency returning to baseline 1.1s. ACME still seeing some failed open connections; might be sticky sessions on drained nodes.
sam: opened HT ticket to revert plugin promotion and cut v2.3.3 back to stable in canary — root cause likely regression in batch path when batch_size>1.
julia: note for RCA: include batch sizing path, TRT plugin alloc behavior, and recent allocator changes in v2.3.4.
incident-bot: Status update: mitigated -> partial (traffic rerouted, hotpatch applied). No longer paging. Continue watch for 20m.
hana (oncall): handing off to morgan for postmortem and follow-up with infra and ML teams. I'll leave the oncall in 10m. :thumbsup:
morgan: taking handoff, will open postmortem doc and coordinate with tamir + sam for permanent rollback or patch. Will include customer impact timeline and mitigation steps.
nora-cs: I'll follow up with customers with an incident timeline draft once you share the postmortem link.

-- End of thread --
